title: “DRAFT: PizzaRioz and A-more!”
text:
Preface

Many years ago, I had a dream. To do what Romans do. Make slow food and fast cars. I cannot do cars, but I thought a PIZZA oven. Introducing ’Tartufo’ (Truffles) the elephant with a heart of gold. So also began the 5Rs of Biometry and more …

In May 2008, we built a pizza oven from first principles based upon the extended family ingenuity, looking at a few locally produced wood-fired pizza ovens. The cover photograph shows the pizza oven we built. 
This e-book is about how we built the oven and the joys of the achievement and the love of living and eating good food! When we were in South Australia during my ‘soixante-dix birthday tour of SA, NSW and NT’ in August 2025, we came across the exhibition of the monumental statues of Salvador Dali works at The Cube on the d’Arenberg Wine Estate. I especially loved the symbol of an elephant, and the angel riding the elephant as shown in Figure 1 below, from the photograph that I took. The significance of this structure is according to the website https://www.daliparis.com/en/gallery/artwork/sculptures/ and I quote:

The elephant, Dalí’s iconoclastic symbol of the future and one of his favourite images, is often depicted atop mosquito-like legs, emphasizing the contrast between robustness and fragility, much like the contrast between the past and modernity. The animal’s jewelled saddle symbolizes wealth, and the dawn of a new era is announced by a flying angel, trumpeting success and prosperity. Dalí’s elephant exemplifies every individual’s hope for abundance and good fortune in the future.







Figure 1: Another elephant by Salvador Dali




There is another e-book that also began its origins in 2008. It is about the ‘modern biometrical methods for the agricultural sciences’ and titled Biometry: the 5Rs’.
Both e-books planned to be released soon on December 1, 2026.

title: 1  How to build a wood fired-pizza oven
text:
The easiest way to build a wood-fired pizza oven is to get someone else to do it! You should do your homework and find out about, cost and construction, as well as efficiency. Do a search of your local area for pizza oven makers. Go and see a few different types or makers and make sure you go to a real live demonstration of their oven.
I spent about 5 years planning, looking at different models, reading about how to make a pizza oven and learning how to lay bricks and mixing mortar and then building the brickwork ready for the the suspended slab for my oven to go on. My father-in-law, Nicola G. helped me make the suspended slab using a cement mixer and then the dome using a similar dome-gauge approach and design as described in Jeavons (2005), which my good friend and former colleague at the Department, Bill W., (the most relaxed entomologist that I have ever met), who lent me his copy.
Check out the book on how to design and build an brick oven and then how to cook and what recipes they suggest. There is a new edition Jeavons and Beer (2024), with a foreword by the famous chef and writer Maggie Beer. My chimney is not as fancy as the one in their book because we used bricks. But some new builders of pizza ovens use stainless steel for their construction to give a clean finish but it is expensive!
TO BE CONTINUED …
